name: Skin Tailor
detailed_description:
Skin Tailor is a gruesome dress up game. Skin your supernatural enemies, create disguises and infiltrate vampire owned blood farms to rescue your comrades.

Story

Vampires invaded your homeland and established themselves as the new rulers. To fill their blood farms they turned your fellow soldiers into war prisoners. You swore to rescue them, even if it means creating disguises made of vampire skin. Your experience as battle surgeon will be perfect for that task.

Find the blood farms, study their layout and convince guards and other related figures to give you access. Only then can you hope to see your comrades again. 

Features 

  • Bloody skin surgeries

  • Dress Up Game Mechanic

    Gather and create equipment for your rescue missions. Make sure you create convincing identities, like a blood farm worker, or even a vampire noble. 

  • Narrative heavy focus. 

  • Gritty and dark art style

  • Medieval and gothic music to emphasize the oppressive world of "Skin Tailor"

  • A vampire companion who provides blood magic to make the tailored skins even more believable and lifelike. But how much can you really trust this human-friendly vampire? Or maybe there's even something more intimate that they desire from you? 

Historical background

The city in which most of the story will be set in is Esztergom, Hungary, in 1241. That was the year it was besieged by the Mongols. In our story, we mix that historical event with dark fantasy, the vampires. We do our best to make a believable world, so lots of historical research has been done as well while writing our gritty story.

  • Processor: 1GHz
  • Memory: 300 MB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX or OpenGL compatible card
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

Minimum:
  • OS: OS X 10.9
  • Processor: 1.8GHz Dual-Core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics

content_descriptors.notes:
The game is about skinning supernatural beings to make your own disguises. It will be very bloody, with a huge emphasis on body horror. 
There will be depression and alcohol abuse.
